## ⚠️ Tier 2: Recurring Problems (Address Soon)

### 1. Front Door Smart Lock Keypad Lag `[OPEN]`
- **Frequency**: Mentioned in summer stay (July 2026).
- **Guest Citation**:
  - *Mark P. (Airbnb, July 22, 2026)*: "Front door lock buttons felt sluggish in afternoon heat, but host gave clear instructions."
- **Root Cause**: Thermal battery strain on exterior Yale smart lock lithium AA cells during Phoenix afternoon temperatures ($>105^\circ\text{F}$), causing keypad touch response lag.
- **Recommended Action**:
  1. Replace current batteries with high-temperature industrial Energizer Ultimate Lithium AA cells during next turnover.
  2. Apply dry graphite lubricant to deadbolt strike pocket to reduce motor mechanical resistance.
  3. Verify keypad wake-up sensitivity in Yale Access App.
